name: DiscImageStudio
one_liner: A free app that turns any photo into a pattern you can burn directly onto the shiny side of a CD, DVD, or Blu-ray disc, so the image is visible to the naked eye.
buyer: An Etsy seller or small gift shop that makes personalized, nostalgic gifts (think custom mixtape CDs, wedding favor discs) for customers who want something tangible and retro.
business_use_cases: An Etsy shop sells 'laser-etched photo discs' as wedding favors, baby-announcement keepsakes, or retro mixtape gifts with a custom image burned onto each one.
A novelty gift kiosk at malls or events offers 'burn your photo onto a disc' as an instant personalized souvenir.
A small print shop adds this as an upsell add-on next to its existing photo-printing and custom-merchandise services.

money_ideas.idea: Sell individual custom-etched discs as physical keepsake products online.
Offer it as a paid upsell add-on at an existing photo/gift printing business.

steal_this: This weekend, burn ten sample discs with different photo styles, list them on Etsy as 'laser-etched keepsake discs,' and see if the novelty gift market bites before investing further.
